content: {DRAFT} If a filter action is applied on a Ethernet frame (i.e. stream), the corresponding EthSwtStreamFilterAction has an EthSwtStream- FilterActionDestinationPortModification configured and the EthSwtStreamFil- terActionDestinationPortModificationType is set to ETHSWT_STREAM_- EGRESS_DESTINATION_EXTEND , then the egress destination of this Ethernet frame shall be extended with the configured egress destination (see EthSwtStreamFil- terActionDestinationPortModificationEgressPortRef ).
